question.text: Saraswati Growth Fund (Cat II AIF) had its FIRST CLOSE on 1 July 2024 and its FINAL CLOSE on 15 October 2024. From which date do Management Fees start to accrue, per standard Indian Cat I/II AIF practice described in Chapter 6?

answer.text: From the date of SEBI registration of the Scheme
Only from the Final Close of the AIF
From the date of the First Close of the AIF
From the first drawdown notice issued to LPs

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 6 states: 'Management Fees shall accrue from the date of the FIRST CLOSE, up to the date when the AIF is dissolved.' First-close investors start the fee clock; subsequent-close investors typically pay catch-up fees to equalise. **The Trap:** A confuses scheme registration with the economics start; C delays accrual (wrong — first-close LPs would unfairly subsidise final-close LPs); D confuses drawdown timing with fee accrual — fees accrue even before a call is issued. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A covers this from the LP/distributor side. XIX-C covered it across categories. SEBI AIF Master Circular sets a 12-month window between first and final close. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Draft your PPM's first-close equalisation mechanics carefully: subsequent-close LPs pay 'interest' (often 8-10%) on the fees and expenses they avoided. This keeps economics fair between Day-1 LPs and late-arriving LPs in the same class.
